FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

More clarity,
from the start.

Which services can I request from Evaris?

You can request risk assessment, occupational health and safety services, and emergency preparedness support. The scope is agreed according to your company's activities.

How is pricing determined?

Your proposal reflects your activities, headcount, job roles, sites and requested services. See how we prepare a quote.

What information is needed for a quote?

Your company name, business activities, headcount, location and sites.

Can I request risk assessment on its own?

Yes. The required documents and information will depend on the workplaces being assessed.

Can I enquire about online training?

Yes. Available services and delivery arrangements are confirmed before entering into an agreement.
